suggestions.name: Altea Care Plan (annual)
suggestions.why: Extends the warranty to 36 months and covers yearly maintenance

Q-608a3c7b.terms:
- **Delivery:** Standard lead time is 5-7 business days for stocked devices, and 15 business days for orders above 50 units [1].
- **Payment:** Accounts with approved credit pay net 30 days from invoice. New accounts pay 50% upfront [1].
- **Warranty:** Devices carry a 24-month warranty. The Care Plan extends it to 36 months and includes yearly maintenance [1].
- **Returns:** Unopened devices can be returned within 30 days, subject to a 10% restocking fee [1].
- **Note:** Partner pricing terms list payment at 45 days from invoice, which differs from the installer terms above [2].
